description: This PHP source file defines the EmployeeLanguageDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It handles database operations related to employee language skills, such as saving, retrieving, deleting, and filtering employee language records. It utilizes Doctrine ORM for database interactions and supports pagination and filtering for employee language data.

classes.name: EmployeeLanguageDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing employee language records, providing methods for CRUD operations, filtering, and pagination.

methods.name: saveEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Persists an EmployeeLanguage entity to the database and returns the saved entity.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguage
methods.description: Retrieves a specific EmployeeLanguage record based on employee number, language ID, and fluency ID.

methods.name: getExistingEmployeeLanguageRecordsForEmpNumber
methods.description: Checks for existing language records for an employee based on a list of language-fluency entries.

methods.name: deleteEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Deletes specified language records for an employee.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Fetches employee language records based on search filter parameters, with pagination.

methods.name: getEmployeeLanguagesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employee language records matching a filter.

methods.name: getAllowedEmployeeLanguages
methods.description: Retrieves a list of languages allowed for an employee, based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getAllowedEmployeeLanguagesCount
methods.description: Returns the count of allowed languages for an employee based on filter parameters.
